content: यथावत् {%ind.%} .²1 Duly, fitly, properly, rightly; <ab>oft.</ab> with the force of an adjective; अध्यापिपद् गाधिसुतो यथावत् <ls>Bk. 2. 21</ls>; लिपेर्यथावद् ग्रहणेन <ls>R. 3. 28</ls>. .²2 According to rule or precept, as enjoined by rules; ततो यथावद् विहिताध्वराय <ls>R. 5. 19</ls>; <ls>Ms. 6. 1</ls>, <ls n="Ms.">8. 214</ls>. .²3 Exactly, truly.
